catholic-encyclopedia-1913-merneptah-i-p: This 1913 reference article on Merneptah — the Egyptian king. Francis Gigot notes his famous stele. He ruled the Nile's wide realm. The age knew the mighty name. The thirteenth century B.C. told his tale. His 1203 death is famed. His stele is famed.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-peter-roh: This biographical entry profiles Peter Roh, a Swiss Jesuit preacher of the 1800s, tracing his career, his sermons, and his place as the 1913 editors recorded it. A compact life from the encyclopedia's Jesuit gallery, preserved among its Swiss mission preachers.
